description: Share a Google Drive file or folder with an email address at a given permission role (reader, commenter, writer). No notification email is sent. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and confirmation plus the new permission id arrive via a follow-up message once it completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Share Drive access on one file or folder id with a single email address at exactly one role, as a background job: reader for view, commenter for view and comment, or writer for edit. Dispatch returns a job_id for tracking; completion delivers the new permission id. An access-control write against Drive, and the grantee receives no notification mail.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the Drive permission grant; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to grant Drive sharing access to an email address.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id/email/role, role is not reader/commenter/writer, or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_found: the file id does not exist. gsuite.permission_denied: the connected account cannot share this file. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: pass role as one of reader/commenter/writer. gsuite.not_found: verify the file id. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
